'''Ran Padell''' was a [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] living in [[Wayfar/Legends|Wayfar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. An expert marksman, he was fond of making jokes and lovely ladies.
